title: eos Shea Better Body Lotion- Vanilla Cashmere, 24-Hour Moisture, 16 fl oz

SHEA BUTTER MOISTURE BARRIER: Powered by our nutrient-rich blend of 7 oils and butters, including wild-harvested shea butter and protective Vitamin E, to soften skin and lock in moisture. FAST-ABSORBING NON-GREASY FORMULA: A lightweight daily body moisturizer that glides on smoothly and absorbs instantly into the skin without leaving a heavy, sticky, or greasy residue. INTOXICATING VANILLA CASHMERE SCENT: Wraps your skin in the internet's favorite gourmand fragrance featuring sensory notes of whipped vanilla, cozy caramel, and soft musk. DERMATOLOGIST RECOMMENDED: Dermatologist-tested, hypoallergenic, and completely free of parabens, phthalates, and gluten. Cruelty-free and designed for your daily self-care routine.
